messages.出血を付けた単体の敵の出血を、薔薇のとげを育てながら強制的に発動させる、色欲貫通: A Bleed-specialized Lust Pierce E.G.O that forcibly triggers the Bleed of a single bleeding enemy while growing Rose Wedge.
messages.出血の強制発動: 破壊不能の4コイン目が、マッチに勝った後に的中すると対象の出血: **Forced Bleed triggers**: When the Unbreakable fourth Coin hits after a Clash Win, it triggers the target's Bleed (at Threadspin Ⅲ, the number of triggers grows with the highest Resonance, up to 3). Bleed Count decreases by the number of triggers.
messages.出血の付与: 1・2コイン目が出血2を付与する。解析Ⅲでは最大共鳴4以上で、出血: **Inflicting Bleed**: The first and second Coins inflict 2 Bleed. At Threadspin Ⅲ, with a highest Resonance of 4 or more, they trigger Bleed once.
messages.薔薇のとげ: 破壊不能の3コイン目で回数が増える。出血ダメージ10ごとに威力が1: **Rose Wedge**: Its Count increases with the Unbreakable third Coin. Its Potency rises by 1 per 10 Bleed damage (up to 10, with a maximum Count of 4). Each time the bearer is inflicted with Bleed, it gains 2 additional Bleed, and the inflicter receives 1 Bleed in return, up to 5 times per turn. At Combat End, if Potency is 10 or Count is 1, it disappears and deals (Potency×10) Lust damage.
messages.コイン威力強化: 解析Ⅲで対象の出血が6以上ならコイン威力+1、Ⅳでは出血6につ: **Coin Power bonus**: At Threadspin Ⅲ, +1 Coin Power if the target has at least 6 Bleed; at Ⅳ, +1 per 6 Bleed, up to 2.
messages.パッシブ「残酷な晩餐」: 出血ダメージを受ける、または与えると、同量だけ体力を回: **Passive — Bloodthirsty Banquet**: Taking or dealing Bleed damage heals the same amount of HP, up to 10 per turn.
messages.出血を扱う編成で、単体の敵に撃つ。出血回数を消耗するので、回数は他の人格で確保す: Use it on a single enemy in a Bleed team. It consumes Bleed Count, so have other Identities secure the Count.
messages.解析Ⅲからは、最大共鳴数が高いほど発動回数が増える。戦闘後半は出血ダメージの累計: From Threadspin Ⅲ, the higher the highest Resonance, the more triggers. Later in battle, Rose Wedge grows from accumulated Bleed damage.
messages.必要資源は色欲4・傲慢3・嫉妬4の計11で重い。精神消耗は覚醒10(使用後3ター: It requires a heavy 11 resources: 4 Lust, 3 Pride, and 4 Envy. Its Awakening Sanity cost is 10 (−10 SP at each Turn End for 3 turns after use).
messages.侵蝕スキルは使用時に体力を消耗し、自分と対象の両方に出血を与える。: The Corrosion skill spends HP on use and inflicts Bleed on both himself and the target.
messages.Ⅲ: 威力が上がり、出血の強制発動が共鳴数で増える。1・2コイン目の追加発動とコ: **Ⅲ**: Raises power, and forced Bleed triggers increase with Resonance. Adds extra triggers on the first and second Coins and the Coin Power bonus.
messages.Ⅳ: 薔薇のとげの回数増加が1から2になり、コイン威力強化が出血6につきに変わる: **Ⅳ**: Rose Wedge's Count increase goes from 1 to 2, and the Coin Power bonus becomes per 6 Bleed.
messages.ラ・マンチャランドの王子: 色欲(S3)・傲慢(S2)・嫉妬(S1)で必要資源の: **[The Prince of La Manchaland](persona:0513)**: Lust (S3), Pride (S2), and Envy (S1) supply all three required affinities, and he can also inflict Bleed.
messages.中指末弟: 嫉妬のS2・守備で嫉妬共鳴に参加でき、S1・S2・守備が出血を付与す: **[The Middle Little Brother](persona:0507)**: His Envy S2 and Defense skill join Envy Resonance, and S1, S2, and his Defense skill inflict Bleed.
